legal.label: Legal
legal.description: Who makes VRX, your privacy, and the license.
legal.independent: VRX is an independent app made by fans. It is not made, published, endorsed, sponsored, supported, or reviewed by the VRChat team or the ChilloutVR team, and it is not affiliated with either team in any way.
legal.vrchat: This application is not created by or affiliated with VRChat or the VRChat team in any way.
legal.chilloutvr: This application is not created by or affiliated with ChilloutVR or the ChilloutVR team in any way.
legal.support: Since neither team makes VRX, they can’t help with it, so please don’t contact them about VRX. If something in VRX goes wrong, report it on VRX’s GitHub page instead.
legal.terms: VRChat and ChilloutVR are named only to say which platforms VRX works with. VRX uses each platform’s unofficial web services, which can change at any time. Each platform’s own terms of service still apply to your account while you use VRX.
legal.privacy: VRX has no accounts of its own, no ads, and no telemetry or analytics. It talks only to VRChat, ChilloutVR, and GitHub (for updates). It never saves your password, and your sign-ins and settings stay on this PC.
legal.license: VRX is free, open-source software under the MIT License, provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. It is built with open-source software, including Electron and React, each under its own license.
